items.name: Escape The Forest Burger
items.description: Crispy vegan fillet with a fresh salad stack, sliced gherkins, vegan mayo and sweet chilli sauce, served in a toasted maple-flavoured seeded bun with seasoned Twister “coaster” fries. Plant-powered and wickedly good no map needed to escape this forest.

items.name: Ministry Of Joy Burger
items.description: Buttermilk fried chicken with a fresh salad stack, mac & cheese, crunchy slaw and Peri-Peri BBQ bacon mayo, packed into a toasted maple-flavoured seeded bun. Served with seasoned Twister “coaster” fries. A seriously twisted chicken stack from the Ministry

items.name: Roller Coaster Burger
items.description: A full-throttle cheeseburger stacked with a fresh salad stack, crunchy pickles, signature Roller Coaster sauce and a double drop of maple ketchup and crispy streaky bacon, all packed into a toasted maple-flavoured seeded bun. Served with seasoned Twister

items.name: Galactica Greens Caesar
items.description: Crisp romaine lettuce, crunchy croutons and grated cheese tossed in a creamy Caesar-style dressing, topped with crunchy streaky bacon, shaved parmesan and chives. A lighter bite inspired by Galactica smooth, gliding and seriously moreish between rides.

items.name: BBQ Peri Peri Chicken Wrap
items.description: Savour crispy chicken tenders coated in BBQ and lemon herb sauces, wrapped in a 12-inch tortilla with fresh mixed leaves and curly fries. Garnished with spring onions, chillies, and chives, this wrap offers a delightful mix of tangy and savoury flavours.

items.name: Wicker Fire Nachos
items.description: Crispy golden nachos topped with creamy plant-based cheese, cool vegan sour cream, fresh zesty salsa, smooth guacamole, fiery red chillies, vibrant chives and crisp spring onion. A full-on blaze of flavour no meat, all heat.

items.name: Wicker Fire Nachos with BBQ Pulled Pork
items.description: Crispy nachos loaded with tender smoky pulled pork, rich BBQ coating, zesty salsa, creamy sour cream, smooth guacamole and topped with fiery chillies, chives and fresh spring onion. A loaded, smoky Wicker feast for bigger appetites.

items.name: Peri-Peri Pit Stop Tenders
items.description: Crispy chicken tenders coated in Peri-Peri BBQ sauce, served on a bed of mixed leaves with curly fries. Finished with spring onions, chillies and chives for a punchy mix of tangy and savoury flavours. A fiery pit stop between rides.

items.name: Rita's Rocket Wings
items.description: Buffalo-tossed chicken wings served on a bed of mixed leaves with cool ranch dressing. Garnished with chillies and chives for an extra kick just like Rita, they don’t hold back. Served with seasoned Twister “coaster” fries.

items.name: Blazing Shicken Tikka Skewers
items.description: Tikka-spiced vegan skewers served on crisp mixed leaves, paired with a cool minted mayo dressing for a fresh, herby contrast to the bold, smoky flavours.

items.name: Dark Forest Wild Boar & Apple Sausage Mash
items.description: Wild boar and apple sausages served on creamy mashed potato with a rich red wine sauce, topped with crispy onions. A hearty, full-flavour ride straight out of the Dark Forest.

items.name: Rita's Quarter Chicken Leg Piri Piri
items.description: Piri Piri Quarter chicken leg roasted until juicy and golden, served with Coaster fries and crunchy sweetcorn ribs. Fast, fiery or fresh you choose the launch on this ride.

items.name: Rita's Quarter Chicken Leg Lemon & Herb
items.description: Lemon & Herb Quarter chicken leg roasted until juicy and golden, served with Coaster fries and crunchy sweetcorn ribs. Fast, fiery or fresh you choose the launch on this ride.

items.name: Coaster Chicken Katsu
items.description: Crispy breaded chicken served with Japanese-style katsu curry sauce, sticky rice and a cucumber and carrot pickle sprinkled with toasted sesame seeds. Crisp, saucy and ultra-satisfying a perfectly balanced katsu run.

items.name: Thai Green Chicken Curry
items.description: Fragrant Thai green curry with tender chicken, vegetables and coconut sauce, served with steamed rice. Fresh, aromatic and full of smooth, rolling drops of flavour.

items.name: Coaster Chicken Tikka
items.description: Marinated chicken tikka in a rich tomato and spice sauce, served with fragrant rice, warm chapati and mango chutney, garnished with fresh coriander and onion seeds. A classic tikka ride with just the right amount of thrill.

items.name: Vegan Shicken Tikka Skewers
items.description: Plant-based “Shicken” tikka skewers grilled and served with fragrant rice, chapati and mango chutney, finished with fresh coriander and onion seeds. All the tikka flavour, none of the meat a plant-powered loop.

items.name: Tomato & Basil Pasta
items.description: Penne pasta tossed in a tomato and basil sauce with parmesan cheese and fresh rocket. A fiery little kick for those who like a sharper drop.

items.name: Kids Cheeseburger & Fries
items.description: CHEESEBURGER 4oz burger in a soft brioche bun with melted cheese, corn cob and fries. Small in size, big on flavour – built for junior coasters.

items.name: Kids Mozzarella Sticks & Fries
items.description: Ooey-gooey cheesy sticks served with a side of skin-on fries. A tasty vegetarian adventure for little riders.

items.name: Fish Fingers & Fries
items.description: Golden crispy fish fingers with a pile of fries. Served with cucumber and carrots sticks.

items.name: Crispy Chicken Nuggets
items.description: Crispy golden chicken nuggets served with a pile of kids fries and maple ketchup. The perfect fuel for your next little adventure.

items.name: Penne Pasta & Tomato Sauce
items.description: Penne pasta tossed in a smooth tomato sauce. Simple, comforting and kid-approved. Ideal for little riders who like to keep things straightforward.

items.name: Sausage & Mash
items.description: Pork sausages served on creamy mashed potato with gravy and peas. A proper classic for little thrill-seekers.

items.name: Curly Fries
items.description: Seasoned Twister “coaster” curly fries. Classic, curly and ready to ride alongside any main.

items.name: Bacon, Bacon Fries
items.description: Twister “coaster” curly fries loaded with crispy bacon pieces and smoky bacon mayo (Smokey Baconnaise), finished with chopped chives. A double-bacon crash of flavour — simple, salty and seriously moreish.

items.name: Mac Balls
items.description: Twister “coaster” curly fries topped with crispy, gooey mac ’n’ cheese bites and drizzled with sweet smoky mayo (Smokey Baconnaise). Finished with chopped chives. Full-on comfort food — the ultimate loaded lap.

items.name: Crunchy Corn Ribs
items.description: Charred sweetcorn “ribs” with a sweet, smoky crunch and seasoning. A funfair-style side with big flavour and even bigger crunch.

items.name: Loop-The-Loop Onion Rings
items.description: Crispy battered onion rings, perfect for sharing. Golden loops made for dipping.

items.name: Mango Sweet Chilli
items.description: Mango chutney with sweet chilli sauce

items.name: Roller Ranch Dip
items.description: Ranch dressing with unique seasonings.

items.name: Spicy Tangy Sweet BBQ
items.description: BBQ sauce with franks original hot sauce

items.name: Phalanx Control Salted Vegan Caramel Cake
items.description: Three layers of rich chocolate sponge filled and iced with salted caramel and chocolate fudge, side-masked and finished with cocoa nibs and a glossy chocolate topping

items.name: Towers Sticky Toffee Pudding
items.description: Classic sticky toffee sponge served warm with custard and vanilla ice cream. Rich, nostalgic and perfect for a slow, sweet finish.

items.name: Salted Caramel Rocky Road Brownie
items.description: Baked brownie loaded with salted caramel and rocky road pieces, served with vanilla ice cream, toffee sauce and Biscoff crumb. Crunchy, gooey and over-the-top a multi-loop dessert.

items.name: Ice Cream Selection
items.description: Choose three flavours from: Vanilla , Strawberry, Triple Chocolate

items.name: Sorbet Selection
items.description: Choose three flavours from: Mango, Raspberry, Lemon
